sources: Movement Disorder Society (MDS) Clinical Diagnostic Criteria
National Institute of Neurological Disorders and Stroke (NINDS)

symptoms.name: Resting Tremor
symptoms.description: Involuntary 4-6 Hz oscillatory shaking occurring predominantly at rest (often pill-rolling in hands). Usually unilateral onset.

symptoms.name: Bradykinesia
symptoms.description: Slowness of movement initiation and execution with progressive decrement in amplitude during repetitive actions.

symptoms.name: Cogwheel Rigidity
symptoms.description: Involuntary muscular stiffness and resistance to passive limb flexion, often feeling like a ratchet or cogwheel.

symptoms.name: Hypophonia & Vocal Dysarthria
symptoms.description: Soft, monotone, or breathy vocal production caused by laryngeal rigidity, glottal tremor, and reduced respiratory support.

symptoms.name: Postural Instability
symptoms.description: Impaired balance, gait freezing, and reduced righting reflexes leading to falls, typically appearing in moderate-to-advanced stages.

symptoms.name: Hyposmia / Loss of Smell
symptoms.description: Reduced olfactory acuity that frequently precedes cardinal motor signs by 5 to 10 years due to early olfactory bulb Lewy pathology.

symptoms.name: REM Sleep Behavior Disorder (RBD)
symptoms.description: Loss of normal muscle atonia during REM sleep causing vivid dream enactment, shouting, or thrashing in bed.

symptoms.name: Dysautonomia & Constipation
symptoms.description: Autonomic nervous system dysfunction affecting enteric nervous system plexuses years prior to clinical motor diagnosis.

symptoms.name: Depression and Anxiety
symptoms.description: Neurochemical disruptions in dopamine, serotonin, and noradrenaline pathways manifesting as mood and motivational changes.

symptoms.name: Cognitive Slowing (Bradyphrenia)
symptoms.description: Executive functioning changes, slowed information processing, and difficulties in multitasking or complex planning.
